children: announced on Wednesday that it acquired three defense technology businesses for a combined $56M, expanding its autonomous defense portfolio across drone detection, communications, and navigation.

include Insignito, which adds acoustic drone detection; Ottopia Defense, which provides AI-powered autonomy and remote-control technology for unmanned systems; and Caribou Labs, which adds navigation and communications capabilities for GPS-denied environments.
The $56M purchase price represents less than 3x the businesses’ expected 2027 revenue, according to the company's forecasts.
The transaction also includes up to $32M in potential earnout payments through 2028, tied to performance milestones.
Ondas also approved equity awards covering 2.98M RSUs and 80K stock options for 37 employees joining through the acquisitions.
The transactions mark its push to combine multiple defense technologies into a broader autonomous systems platform and expand its addressable markets.
